title: Subject and Project Type Relations
standing: Exploratory comparison model. Definitions and constructed witnesses are explicit assumptions for testing; this is not a replacement canonical hierarchy.
terms: A change that makes a stated result better than a baseline under a stated standard.
Removing one unwanted scratch improves a surface under a smoothness criterion without elaborating a structure, teaching an agent, or generating an idea.
An activity aimed at producing better results; or a better successor artifact rather than the change itself.
A process that forms or elaborates an organization, structure, or capacity over time; betterment is not required.
Elaborating a software architecture adds interacting components while making its stated task slower and less reliable.
Development as advancement under a chosen standard; this would make improvement part of the definition.
A capability to adaptively select, construct, and use means across a stated range of situations.
An agent retains the capacity to choose a familiar effective route even while resting and producing nothing new.
An ongoing activity of improving available possibilities, or a system that carries out such activity.
A process that brings a new item or arrangement into existence; novelty is relative to an explicit identity and baseline.
Constructing a new unusable arrangement for no identified difficulty creates something while worsening the accepted result and requiring no new learning.
Any production of a new state, including selection and inference; this broadening risks making all change creation.
A lasting change in an agent's dispositions or usable means attributable to experience or prior results.
Repeated misleading feedback induces a persistent less effective response; the agent has changed through experience but performs worse.
A capacity to update; acquisition of true content; or any system-state update, each requiring a different comparison.
A process of making transitions among questions, claims, assumptions, possibilities, and other intellectual material.
Checking a familiar inference repeats an intellectual transition without producing a new method or improving the result.
A repertoire or capability for such transitions; or all adaptive transformation of a situation.
A change in what is available to a specified investigation or inquirer relative to an earlier position; truth is separately assessed.
Recovering an old question makes it new to this inquiry without creating that question or establishing its answer.
Discovery restricted to true novel findings, or the process of seeking them rather than the acquisition increment.
A capability to use specified relations to distinguish, explain, or handle relevant cases, beyond reproducing their wording.
A person retains usable grasp of a route while not presently reasoning, explaining, or changing any capability.
An explanatory account, an achieved epistemic state, or the activity of developing grasp.
A capability to generate materially different possibilities under stated conditions.
A person can generate several forms when called upon but currently generates nothing; the capacity remains.
The activity of generation, or a novelty/quality attributed to a product; either can change the hierarchy.
Anything that can be considered. This is a potential role, not a claim that everything is currently being attended to.
An unexamined stone can be considered without being a method, capability, process, or designed artifact.
A matter actually under consideration; a discipline; or a grammatical subject. These are different scopes.
Specifications of intended outcomes and the conditions that would count as their achievement.
A stated goal to preserve prior corrections specifies an outcome without specifying a plan or proving that the outcome is good.
Desired states themselves; actual pursuit; or commitments to pursue, rather than specifications.
Contextual favoring relations involving an agent, alternatives or features, and relevant circumstances.
An agent favors a name but neither adopts it nor judges it morally better.
A standing disposition, observed choice, or rule that ranks alternatives rather than the favoring relation.
Standards or grounds of worth that specify what deserves favor or consideration in a context.
A standard of fairness remains stated while an agent prefers an unfair option and undertakes no action.
What an agent actually favors; values as constraints; or values as effects of an allocation pattern.
An act of assessing a matter and reaching or revising a verdict under stated grounds or criteria.
A correct assessment confirms an unchanged verdict and makes no new commitment or improvement.
The verdict, the standard, or the capability to assess rather than an assessing act.
Acts that resolve whether to adopt, reject, defer, withdraw, or reopen an operative option.
An agent defers a choice among already understood options; no new option or improvement results.
The resulting commitment state; all cognitive selection; or the choice procedure as an artifact.
Specifications of requested distinctions, referents, assumptions, and resolution conditions.
An unanswered question recorded on paper is a specification, not an act of searching, a capacity, or an answer.
Acts of asking; uncertainty states; or any distinction that can guide work.
A process of exploring candidates or locations for a stated target, possibly constructing candidates and changing the space.
A fruitless search through existing files examines candidates but discovers no target and creates no new candidate.
Search as all traversal of possibilities, including reasoning and design; or retrieval alone.
A disposition or attraction toward finding out about something, without requiring pursuit or novelty.
An agent remains interested in a question while choosing not to investigate or formulate a goal around it.
Curiosity as a preference, an inquiry-generating operation, or control of exploratory attention.
A sustained investigative process organized to establish or revise findings concerning specified matters.
An investigation reproduces an existing result and finds no new fact or improvement.
A programme, method, institution, or corpus of findings rather than the investigative activity.
A field or family of investigative practices concerning empirically examinable accounts; scientific outputs are not automatically true.
A scientific field includes competing and unsuccessful accounts; the field is not itself one true claim or one successful discovery.
A particular empirical investigation, its method, or its established body of findings.
A field of investigation into concepts, grounds, implications, and fundamental questions; no complete conventional boundary is assumed.
A philosophical field includes unresolved competing positions; the field is not itself a verdict or an episode of successful problem solving.
Conceptual inquiry as an operation that can occur within every other project or field.
An operation that identifies or formulates a particular obstruction, mismatch, or unresolved requirement.
An agent formulates a known obstruction more precisely while finding no remedy and committing to no intervention.
Making a problem newly available to an inquirer, which is a discovery increment rather than its formulation process.
An activity directed toward removing an identified difficulty; attempts can fail, and success must be distinguished.
An attempted repair applies an existing routine but fails to remove the difficulty.
Successful resolution only; or all activity interpreted relative to an obstacle, which expands the scope drastically.
An account that represents how a specified occurrence or pattern depends on stated factors or conditions.
An old written explanation states a dependence account while nobody is presently explaining and its truth remains disputed.
An act of explaining, a causal mechanism itself, or a recipient's achieved understanding.
A representation of an outcome made before that outcome is available to the predictor.
A recorded forecast is false when the outcome arrives and is not a causal explanation of it.
The forecasting operation, the capacity to predict, or a conditional consequence regardless of temporal availability.
The holding of what an assertion says under its stated interpretation; not the assertion or the evidence for it.
An unrecognized proposition can hold without being known, discovered, expressed as a prediction, or used by any agent.
A relation between content and what obtains; a norm of assertion; or the inquiry that tests a claim.
An epistemic position in which specified alternatives remain unresolved for an agent or inquiry.
An agent remains uncertain about a known question while performing no search, making no decision, and creating nothing.
A set of alternatives, a probability representation, or a condition deliberately generated by an operation.
A state of possessing true content with adequate grounds under a declared account of knowing; this is a working sense, not a completed theory.
An agent knows a fixed access code without presently creating, searching, learning, or producing a new explanation.
Retained content, actionable differences, or usable capacity; each changes several type claims.
A relation by which earlier material or results remain available to later work, with identity and relevant context preserved.
A retained false claim remains recoverable even though it is neither true knowledge nor a new discovery.
Stored material, recovery activity, a capability, or a subsystem rather than retention/availability.
An expression or form used to stand for specified content or distinctions; the representing relation is a different sense.
A deliberately drawn map represents an existing route without being the route, a skill, or an ongoing activity.
The content-to-form relation; the operation of constructing a form; or all state that distinguishes alternatives.
Relations linking specified terms or positions; treated extensionally as the same broad relation class in this comparison.
An adjacency relation connects two positions without favoring either, retaining earlier results, or contributing to a particular goal.
A connective act, a graph edge record, or any transformation of a configuration.
A contribution relation between some material and a specified concern under stated conditions.
A forgotten warning can be relevant to a live decision without being noticed, preferred, or acted upon.
The process of selecting contributions; a score; or the property of a bearer relative to a goal.
A process of allocating operative focus among available contents or activities.
Attention repeatedly returns to irrelevant material without learning, solving the live problem, or improving the result.
A state of focus; a capacity; or control of all resource allocation rather than only operative focus.
Things available or potentially available for a specified use; a role relative to use rather than an intrinsic material kind.
An unmodified stone available as a paperweight is a resource without being an authored artifact, method, or intellectual capability.
The available means themselves; resource configurations; or every entity viewed through potential use.
A proposed arrangement of later actions, dependencies, and contingencies; this comparison uses the plan/result sense.
An unexecuted course with branches remains a plan while nobody performs it or improves anything.
The process of producing a plan rather than the resulting arrangement.
A proposed arrangement or policy governing later action under conditions; the shared course sense is used here.
An unexecuted conditional course remains a strategy without actual action or established improvement.
A competitive policy, a selection principle, or a method for generating courses; these can distinguish it from a plan.
An occurrence of doing under an agent's direction or control, rather than the plan, capability, or record of it.
An agent repeats a routine movement that creates no new arrangement, resolves no difficulty, and improves nothing.
All causally effective change, including processes without an agent; or a specified operation type.
A process in which contributions are addressed or made available for interpretation within an interaction; success is not required.
An unsuccessful spoken warning communicates a contribution without written text, new knowledge, or improvement.
The conveyed content, a coordination relation, or any influence between systems.
A process of constructing or revising text, including substantive intellectual work performed through that construction.
Copying a familiar sentence by rote produces text without resolving a new problem or changing a capability.
The written artifact; writing as reasoning; or writing as a sequence of changes in a reader's understanding.
A process of addressing instructions or contextual contributions to a model to influence its work.
A model receives an instruction and responds incorrectly; a prompting episode occurred without improvement or successful learning.
The prompt artifact; a control interface; or a local system for selecting and revising operations.
Withdrawn label: the user's intended meaning is unresolved. No marketing meaning or Prompting substitution is supplied.
A process of developing or assessing candidate form and requirements in relation to intended use and feasibility.
A design review tests only existing forms against unchanged requirements and abandons the task; no new candidate form is created relative to its declared form-identity baseline.
The proposed form or specification; general form–requirement relations; or selection among already complete designs.
An organized arrangement of interacting components considered through their joint behavior or function.
A malfunctioning mechanism remains an organized interacting arrangement although it has no adaptive intelligence and produces no improvement.
The process carried out, a software artifact, a method, or a role in a larger system.
A bounded purposeful undertaking with coordinated work and intended results; here the undertaking, not its repository, is classified.
An undertaking applies familiar methods but ends without achieving its intended outcome or producing a new artifact.
The repository, project plan, collection of artifacts, or named system being developed.
A specified repeatable way of performing work, considered as a prescription rather than a particular execution.
A written repeatable recipe remains a method while it is not being executed and while no capability has improved.
An execution of the prescription, an informal habitual pattern, or a capability to act in a certain way.
An authored organization of concepts, distinctions, and relations used to structure further consideration or work.
A static conceptual framework organizes distinctions but prescribes no complete procedure and demonstrates no intelligence.
A reusable operating architecture, a theory of the whole subject space, or merely a presentation layout.
Something deliberately employed as a means of observing, altering, or accomplishing a specified result; successful use is not required.
A naturally occurring stone deliberately used as a weight is an instrument without being an authored artifact or an intelligent capability.
An authored tool only; an operation; or every means that changes which contributions are possible.
An authored artifact used or provided for performing a specified operation.
A simple authored cutting tool has a use without being a procedure, a learning event, or an adaptive capability.
Any means, including a question, constraint, or natural object; this would collapse the artifact restriction.
An occurrence unfolding through an ordered course over time; intention, benefit, and novelty are not required.
A passive periodic fluctuation unfolds over time without an agent's action, inquiry, or intended result.
A procedure specification, a causal mechanism, or any ordered relation whether executed or not.
An identifiable process that transforms or selects material under stated input and occurrence conditions.
An automatic selection operation picks an already available option without creating it or learning anything.
The repeatable operation specification rather than its execution, or every state transition.
A disposition or ability to perform specified work under conditions, distinguished from its current exercise.
A fixed capacity to bear a load persists without adaptive selection, learning, or any ongoing exercise of that capacity.
Observed performance, a resource, or a configuration that realizes the ability.
A specified way in which terms or positions stand to one another, considered as the relation rather than its expression.
A numerical ordering relation does not itself retain earlier experience, favor an alternative, or guide a particular inquiry.
A relation instance, a relational predicate, an edge in a representation, or a connecting process.
A difference between specified earlier and later states or positions; improvement and deliberate transformation are not required.
An irrelevant deterioration changes a state without improving it, teaching an agent, or constituting organized development.
A process producing the difference, a comparison between alternatives, or every re-description of a fixed state.
Something produced or established by specified work or a process, considered in that result role.
A failed process leaves an unintended broken part as its result, with no improvement or new knowledge.
An intended outcome, an observation, a retained artifact, or any later state whether attributable to work or not.
An intentionally produced item or expression, including authored prescriptions and representations; merely selecting a natural object does not make it authored.
A deliberately made blank tile is an artifact without representing assigned content, prescribing a method, or serving a supplied tool function.
A physical object only, a produced result, or a software implementation rather than its specification.
A representation used to examine or draw consequences concerning a specified target or possible arrangement.
A model represents a possible mechanism while remaining empirically false and supporting no successful forecast.
An executing predictive system, a theory, an exemplar to copy, or any simplified representation.
An organized domain of investigative concerns and practices, considered as a domain rather than a particular investigation.
A field contains unresolved, failed, and competing investigations; the field is not one occurrence or one known result.
The collective investigation as a process, an institutional system, or a subject scope.
A class defined by membership conditions, considered as a class rather than one of its members.
The class of red tiles is a type; it is not an act of painting, a capability, or a designed tile instance.
A predicate, a conceptual distinction, a role, or a data-type implementation.
An assessing operation that determines status or comparative merit under specified criteria.
Applying a fixed criterion confirms an unchanged assessment and makes neither a new criterion nor a commitment.
The standard, score, result, or causal measurement system rather than an assessment act.
A process arranging interactions or compatibility among components so they can function together.
Connecting two components creates an integrated arrangement that performs worse than the earlier separated configuration.
A resulting compatibility relation, a system property, or any cross-subject use of a finding.
A configuration in which specified work executes without repeated local human selection or intervention.
A fixed timer automatically repeats an unhelpful operation without learning or adaptive intelligence.
The process of making work automatic, the resulting behavior, or autonomy over goals rather than repeated execution.
Improvement in which the system producing or governing the change is also the specified target that becomes better.
A system repairs its own known defect through a fixed routine without learning a new response or acquiring adaptive intelligence.
A recursive improvement method, an ambition, or any internal change regardless of comparative benefit.
A deliberately organized activity intended to develop another agent's understanding or capabilities; effectiveness is not entailed.
An organized teaching activity fails to produce lasting learning in the learner.
An institution, a curriculum artifact, self-directed learning, or the achieved capability change.
A process in which multiple agents coordinate contributions to shared work.
Two agents coordinate routine work but worsen the result and learn nothing new.
A relation among agents, a division-of-work configuration, or communication of any kind.
A process assigning means, capacity, or access to uses under conditions.
A fixed allocation rule assigns resources inefficiently without creating a better arrangement or learning from the outcome.
The resulting distribution, all relations between means and uses, or a universal frame for every subject.
A specified arrangement of elements and relations, considered as an arrangement rather than the act of producing it.
An arrangement of unconnected spare parts is a configuration without joint system behavior or automatic execution.
The configuring operation, an authored design, or a complete state including possible transitions.
An operation resolving which alternative or subset is used, retained, attended to, or adopted under stated conditions.
An automatic filter retains an existing record without creating the record, making an agent's commitment, or learning.
The selected result, the criterion, a preference relation, or any constraint that reduces alternatives.
A condition restricting admissible configurations, actions, or results in a stated context.
A fixed physical size limit restricts feasible configurations without being a value judgment, preference, method, or process.
An active enforcing operation, a soft preference, or a representation of a restriction.
A relation by which a result becomes available to influence subsequent work, without requiring learning or benefit.
A result is returned to a fixed controller that repeats the same rule and makes the result worse.
A message, a return operation, an update, or any recurrence of prior results.
A change specified through how a target state or arrangement is altered into another.
A specified permutation alters an arrangement without improving it, elaborating it, or updating an agent through experience.
A transformation rule or mathematical mapping, rather than the change it describes.
disjoint_sense_rules: A retained ability is not the occurrence that exercises it; this rule fixes the capacity/occurrence distinction for the primary senses.
An ability is not a before/after change in that ability; acquiring or improving a capability is a different classified item.
A specified or produced item is not the process producing or using it in these primary senses.
An item or prescription is not the change that produced or revised it in these primary senses.
The relation considered abstractly is not a process that establishes or uses it; a process can instantiate a relation without being that relation.
A relation is not its deliberately made expression or edge record under these primary senses.
A membership class is not an occurrence of one of its members.
A class is not the change in one of its members or in a record describing the class.
The domain of investigative concerns is distinguished here from an individual or collective investigation conducted in it.
extra_examples: A deliberately developed replacement interface removes a stated obstacle and is better under the same standard.
A new automatic routine generates many useless forms without adapting its selection rule.
A lasting experience-induced update produces better transfer on an agreed class of tasks.
An existing idea is retrieved and thereby becomes newly available to an inquiry.
A generative search constructs a new question whose distinction changes the next inquiry.
An exploratory reasoning process generates a new candidate explanation rather than deducing a known conclusion.
A writer revises text and through the revision discovers a new premise required by the argument.
A prompted model receives a deliberately communicated instruction.
An interactive lesson coordinates teacher and learner contributions to a shared exercise.
A fixed constraint is deliberately used to restrict an otherwise unbounded search.
An explicitly formulated question is used as an instrument for distinguishing a preference.
A retained method specification is supplied as a tool for carrying out a particular inference check.
A capability for generating materially different suitable means is part of an agent's adaptive intellectual ability.
Usable grasp of the relations in a changing task enables adaptive selection of means across that task range.
An integrated automated controller is an interacting arrangement whose work repeats without local human intervention.
A framework is explicitly provided as a tool to organize a user's inquiry.
A conceptual investigation assesses competing definitions and reaches a revised verdict.
A reflective selection act adopts a course as the agent's operative commitment.
An authored conditional course is used as a model to examine consequences before execution.
An explanation is explicitly used as a model for deriving consequences about its target.
A once-neutral result becomes a deliberately employed resource in a later inquiry.
A fixed self-repair changes a system for the better under its original standard.
An allocation act deliberately selects a subset of available means for a specified use.
An old retained result is fed back into later work while retaining its original status and context.
related_predicates: A capability can enable a creating process; the capability and its exercise are not the same item.
Intelligence can support improvement and can itself be the target of improvement.
A change can improve an intellectual capability or result from its exercise without being that capability.
A developing process may be bettering, worsening, or neutral under a specified criterion.
Experience can modify capability; the update need not be an instance of the capability modified.
can result from / overlap under other senses
A creating process can make something newly available, while recovery can do so without creation.
A question can govern reasoning and be constructed through it without being a reasoning episode.
A goal specifies an intended outcome; several courses can be developed for it.
A favoring relation can inform a commitment without resolving it.
A standard of worth can justify or challenge actual favoring; descriptive agreement is not entailed.
Retained results can enable an update without guaranteeing it occurred.
can be required by a definition
In the working sense, known content must be true; truth itself is not a knowing state.
A form can expose or hide relations without itself being a usable capability.
Prompting can direct a reasoning process; an episode can also include reasoning by its author.
A field includes investigative practices; this is not the field itself being an individual investigation.
A domain can study and use reasoning without being identical to each reasoning process.
An organized arrangement can implement a prescription while retaining its distinct realization conditions.
Automatic repetition does not require adaptive capability; an automated configuration can nevertheless use it.
Assessment can establish whether a change is better, without producing the change.
Arranging interactions can produce a functioning system; the process and resulting arrangement differ.
Constructing text can perform substantive intellectual transitions; it need not merely report completed reasoning.
The availability of a result does not entail the experience-dependent update.
A restriction can prompt construction of alternatives without itself being a creating process.
Contribution to the task can be recognized or missed by the process allocating focus.
